verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Anytype publishes its own MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) can call Anytype's tools, and an 'agent skill' for external agents to script against Anytype data — this is the reverse direction of the story. There is no evidence that Anytype itself acts as an MCP client, letting users plug external MCP servers into Anytype so it can use their tools.
